senses.gloss: something kneaded together, a handful, ball, lump.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67b:13">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 128b:16">128ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ של מלח</he> a lump of salt.
B. Mets. 90ᵃ ב׳ מאותו המין a handful (fodder) of the same species; v. infra.—Pl. בּוּלוֹת, בּוּלִים, בּוּלִין clods, v. next w.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:12">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>ב׳ ב׳ של אדמה</he> clods of moist ground.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:13">Num. R. s. 2</cite> sand is thrown into the fire <he>ומוציאו בולים</he> and he brings it out as lumps (of glass); v. <cite ref="B00270"><he>בּוּלָס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:3">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> (expl. <he>בול הרים</he> <cite ref="Job 40:20">Job XL, 20</cite>); Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12.
